motion.name: scene-time
motion.value: Scroll progress moves light from 04:00 through the following 04:00 and sends a wind gust through the standing wave field; it does not add impact rings. Idle timers also schedule natural events.
motion.purpose: Let the visitor scrub one day of changing light while scroll wind and independently timed events animate the lake.

narrative.overview: One Japanese lakeside scene carries time from dawn to night. The lake keeps low, continuous swells; scroll wind strengthens those waves without adding impact rings. Weather gathers and fades in patches, while occasional animals and seasonal events disturb the water.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous scene instead of a slide sequence
A moving reflective lake with low swells and localized impact ripples
Scroll drives a wind gust through the wave field without creating circular impacts
Idle timers bring weather, wildlife, seasons, and rare sky events

rules.name: One Scene Rule
rules.body: Scroll progress changes the lighting continuously across the same scene.

rules.name: Water Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep low swells in continuous motion; let scroll add wind through the wave field without impact rings, and map pointer or natural impacts into lake coordinates.

dos: Keep the torii visually grounded at the lake surface.
Keep long swells moving while reserving local rings for pointer contact and natural impacts.
Let scroll progress change lighting and send a gust through the same wave field.
donts: Don't use horizontal slide transitions between scenes.
Don't mirror the full screen to fake a water reflection.
Don't replace moving water with a static decorative pattern.
